results.content: This research work aims at identifying the importance and status of constitutional balances in Jordan and their impact on political life (a field study in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan), where the researcher will use the realistic inductive approach, relying on his extensive knowledge and research in several books and legal studies. Through his work in the field of law as a professor in one of the prestigious Jordanian universities, specifically in the Faculty of Law, and by virtue of his previous experiences in political and administrative work in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, and through his follow-up, reading, and knowledge of the provisions of the Jordanian Constitution and its amendments, the researcher tried in this study to focus on the most important factors affecting stability and Constitutional balances and their impact on the Jordanian political system and the citizens, and how this system is contributing to maintaining the political, social and economic stability of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.
